summary.intent: Verify that phase 71 ("share-invite-security-and-ipns-data-integrity-api") of the cipher-box project met all its planned must-haves, then close out the phase in the GSD workflow.
summary.outcome: Verification agent confirmed 16/16 truths against actual source (not just SUMMARY claims), including a live database test proving the claim_count CHECK constraint (SQLSTATE 23514) inside a rolled-back transaction; phase 71 was marked complete with no warnings and the project advanced to phase 72.

repo: Invite/share creation (createInvite, createShare) is gated on an ipns_records creator marker and throws ForbiddenException (403) on mismatch.

claim_count on ipns_records has a live-enforced Postgres CHECK constraint (SQLSTATE 23514) preventing negative values — verified directly against the running cipherbox-postgres container, not just documented.
revokeForItems uses a single createQueryBuilder().delete() call rather than manager.find/remove, for efficient bulk revocation.
claimInvite's existing-share merge path is widen-only and explicitly never downgrades encryptedWriteKey.
The term 'descriptor' was fully purged from apps/api/src/shares and across sdk-core/sdk/web/sdk-e2e/Rust as part of this phase's cleanup (D-10).

code.finding: createInvite gates on ipns_records creator marker, throws ForbiddenException (403) on mismatch
createShare has matching creator-marker gate and 403 behavior as createInvite
Contains same-seq CID equivocation guard and first-publish 409 translation (D-05/D-06), with unit tests and a live concurrent-race proof (Test 21)

workflow: GSD phase verification independently re-derives evidence from source code rather than trusting the phase's own SUMMARY.md, and can upgrade a documented-manual backstop claim to directly-observed behavioral evidence (e.g., running a live SQL test in BEGIN…ROLLBACK).
Phase completion checks for anti-pattern markers (TBD/FIXME/XXX/TODO/HACK/placeholder) in touched files as part of the passing criteria.
A task-notification for a background verification agent can fire once it stops with no live children; the same task-id may notify again if resumed.

open_items: Proceed to phase 72 now that phase 71 is closed out.
SHARE-WRITE-KEY threading gap noted in prior project memory (collectChildKeys superseded) remains open and wasn't addressed by this phase's verification.
